question: Who can allocate and reassign?
selected_answer: Appointed senior/manager with allocate permission or partner; routine transfer needs no second administrative approval.
contrary_case: Account administrator alone cannot make audit judgments.

question: How many preparers/reviewers?
selected_answer: Many named people per engagement/work item, one accountable lead preparer/reviewer for ordinary active work; scope-specific contributors.
contrary_case: No fixed three-person minimum and no shared login masquerading as multiple people.

question: Can seniors prepare work?
selected_answer: Yes; a different eligible person reviews their substantive contribution under retained product control.
contrary_case: A different capacity or second account for the same person does not make review independent.

question: Is EQR an ordinary reviewer/team member?
selected_answer: No; separate outside-team appointment/access, eligibility and applicable cooling-off; existing EQR workflow owns completion.
contrary_case: Restricted engagement access does not make EQR a team member.

question: What moves on reassignment?
selected_answer: Selected open work/requests/queues and explicitly replaced future allocations; historical authorship, time, reviews and notes remain.
contrary_case: A reviewer replacement does not erase existing notes or impersonate old signatures.

question: What is availability?
selected_answer: Daily scheduled elapsed minutes minus clipped union of unavailable intervals; explicit unknown and known zero; time zone/calendar revision.
contrary_case: No assumed full-time week; holiday and leave overlap deducted once.

question: How are scenario alternatives counted?
selected_answer: Each alternative replaces exact baseline IDs then adds its own allocations; commit one scenario transactionally against current revisions.
contrary_case: Never add mutually exclusive alternatives together or erase past actuals.

question: What happens with overbooking?
selected_answer: Show daily excess and zero/unknown capacity; require resolution before positive sufficiency; bounded partner-approved planning exception remains visible.
contrary_case: A planning exception cannot waive law, authority or ethical restrictions.

question: What is planned/actual/budget variance?
selected_answer: Same scope and cutoff; actual minus plan, base plan; original/revised budgets separate; incomplete actuals provisional; zero denominators null.
contrary_case: An unfinished engagement is not over budget merely from partial-period comparisons.

question: Is external credential API required?
selected_answer: No; issuer/type/ID/evidence/validity/verification/evaluator register and manual external lookup if actually performed.
contrary_case: Uploaded image is not externally verified; title is not scope of practice.

question: Does every assistant need partner credentials?
selected_answer: No; authority required for legally reserved acts/roles, task competence assessed separately; relevant Mongolian person/firm evidence recorded.
contrary_case: Multiple engagements in one firm are distinct from prohibited dual employment/other-firm arrangements.

question: What if expiry is blank?
selected_answer: Unknown until evidenced; explicit supported no-expiry allowed; degree does not get invented annual expiry; practising standing separate.
contrary_case: Renewal or replacement file never silently rewrites earlier authority.

question: Are all specialists ISA620 experts?
selected_answer: No; classify actual engagement team/internal expert/external expert/management expert/component/internal-audit/direct-assistance/legal-enquiry/EQR.
contrary_case: Lawyer title alone does not determine which standard applies.

question: Does prior client employment automatically ban expert for five years?
selected_answer: No universal ISA620 ban; retain printed statement, dates and qualified disclosure; assess actual objectivity/legal/firm-policy rule via D01 route.
contrary_case: Do not delete disclosure or convert stricter firm policy into universal law.

question: What may senior share?
selected_answer: Exact selected-file or frozen engagement-selected packet; recipient/purpose/action/expiry/revoke/agreement/disclosure basis; no firm-wide wildcard.
contrary_case: New or replaced files require a new authorized manifest.

question: Is specialist portal necessary for v1?
selected_answer: No; required secure manual packet/dispatch/receipt/return route is specified; optional portal must enforce the same contract.
contrary_case: No approved channel means prepared packet is retained until authorized dispatch, not an insecure fallback.

question: Does receipt of expert opinion complete audit work?
selected_answer: No; record provenance then auditor evaluates findings/methods/data and resolves inadequacy; expert cannot self-clear/opine on whole audit.
contrary_case: A signed PDF is not automatically sufficient appropriate audit evidence.

question: Can revocation recall downloaded copies?
selected_answer: No; stop future server/provider access; record actual return/deletion request and acknowledgment; preserve audit-firm records.
contrary_case: View-only cannot promise screenshot prevention.

question: How is internal direct assistance treated?
selected_answer: Specific legality/objectivity/competence/task limits/written agreements/review record; no blanket local permission or prohibition inferred.
contrary_case: ISA610 cannot waive prohibition; this is an engagement fact assessment, not unfinished product research.

question: Are workbook and local edition still open?
selected_answer: No; carry accepted workbook and Mongolian 2020 compilation with integrated quality updates from D01 without reopening.
contrary_case: New international releases are version/profile review triggers only.

question: Which IFRS formula governs staffing load?
selected_answer: None: D02 measures resource minutes; expert substantive methods carry separately selected accounting framework and owning method.
contrary_case: Do not relabel a staffing ratio as an IFRS/IAS financial measurement.
